## ShardingSphere SQL Server Table Hint Parsing

The classes you're asking about are part of ShardingSphere's SQL parser for SQL Server dialect, located in the `org.apache.shardingsphere.sql.parser.sql.dialect.segment.sqlserver.hint` package.

## Background on SQL Server Table Hints

These segments correspond to actual SQL Server T-SQL functionality. According to Microsoft's documentation, table hints override the default behavior of the query optimizer during the DML operation. The `WITH (...)` table hint clause is what `WithTableHintSegment` parses, while `TableHintLimitedSegment` typically represents the more restricted set of hints allowed in INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE statements (as opposed to the full set allowed in SELECT).
